title: 1314-1318 and 1324 Wharf Street Johnson Street Gateway: preliminary code review

facts.text: Project is at 1314-1318 and 1324 Wharf Street, Victoria.
Review describes new eight-storey building interfacing with two existing two-storey heritage buildings; governing code 2012 BCBC Part 3.
Anticipated AS topics include combustible construction, floor FRR, number of exits, dead-end corridor, exposure to exit, and live-work use.
Report says full AS details require later design refinement for building-permit submission.

limitations: British Columbia comparative material only; it cannot establish Alberta code performance or applicability.
